L49-D01.text: Do you want any meat today, Mrs. Bird?

L49-D01.speaker: man

L49-D03.text: Do you want beef or lamb?
L49-D03.speaker: man

L49-D06.text: I like lamb, but my husband doesn't.
L49-D06.translation: 我喜欢羊肉，但我丈夫不喜欢。
L49-D06.speaker: woman

L49-D10.text: And a pound of mince, too.
L49-D10.speaker: woman

L49-D11.text: Do you want a chicken, Mrs. Bird?
L49-D11.translation: 伯德太太，您想要一只鸡吗？
L49-D11.speaker: man

L49-D14.text: My husband likes steak, but he doesn't like chicken.
L49-D14.translation: 我丈夫喜欢牛排，但不喜欢鸡肉。
L49-D14.speaker: woman

L49-D15.text: To tell you the truth, Mrs. Bird, I don't like chicken either!
L49-D15.translation: 说实话，伯德太太，我也不喜欢鸡肉！
L49-D15.speaker: man

L49-N-GRAMMAR.text: 第三人称单数肯定句常用 likes/wants；否定句用 doesn’t like/want，动词不再加 s。either 放在否定句末表示“也不”。tomato/potato 的复数加 es。
